query:
SELECT qli.id, qli.quote_id, qli.component_name, qli.description, qli.unit_price, qli.quantity, qli.total_price, qli.repair_type
FROM quote_line_items qli
WHERE qli.quote_id IN ('4620001', '4650001')
ORDER BY qli.quote_id, qli.id
LIMIT 50;
